requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

7-4399-4770--228.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
7-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Hamza.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
7-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

240-5470-6965-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

728-3249-3755-5004.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

4247-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-7936--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

803-5310-6879-8095.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-5310-6879-8095.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1734-4681-6495.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
1734-4681-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-3899-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2438-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 5.

851-1308-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1976-3532-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

215-1526-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-1879.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1322-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1322-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1170-5195-7516.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Adventurous Eater // Have a Bite.
When you cast this, Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Adventurous Eater // Have a Bite, which enters prepared.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

457-1329-3338-5901-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2366-3688-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-4677-5413.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4677-5413.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

539-2511-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

826-1636-3967-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1497-2173-5220-6578.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
1497-2173-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2034-2534-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Coercive Recruiter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

11-799-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-799-5131-6276.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
You have max speed.
11-799-5131-6276.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-799-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

972-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
You have enough mana to cast Saheeli's Artistry
972-1329-3169-4050.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3809-3867-4231-5032.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}, creating one Food, one Clue, and one Treasure token, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

562-2512-2603.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Warrior en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Warrior en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1947-2231-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

430-727-1061.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Assemble the Legion triggers, putting a muster counter on itself and creating a copy of Timestream Navigator with haste for each Muster counter on Assemble the Legion.
Activate a copy of Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

1283-4222-5089.notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-4222-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3106-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional creature token.
2034-3106-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Grismold triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
